lines.speaker: test_npc
lines.text: P-Penni... I can't keep fighting. Everything hurts...

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Silas! You're hurt. I'm taking you somewhere safe.

lines.speaker: test_npc
lines.text: Out of the water? But... I don't know if I can...

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: You don't have to. I'll get you there. Just stay with me.
